title: Anthropic's belief in its own commitment to safety gives Anthropic the license to aggressively favor its business and even challenge the US government (Ben Thompson/Stratechery)
summary: Ben Thompson / Stratechery: Anthropic's belief in its own commitment to safety gives Anthropic the license to aggressively favor its business and even challenge the US government — I'm sympathetic to the cynics who consistently characterize Anthropic's public statements, particularly those surrounding their model releases …
